subject: Onboarding: OxStream AP portal, self-billing & remit-split requirements
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@oxstream.com>, Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@oxstream.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: OxStream AP portal, self-billing & remit-split requirements

Hi Liam / Sofia —

Thanks for the quick chat earlier. To make the vendor registration go smoothly from our side, can you confirm the following items your AP portal requires so we can prepare a single package for upload? We want to avoid repeated back-and-forth once we submit the vendor record.

Requested items from Redwood (what we plan to upload):
- Legal entity name + any alternative remit name you require
- Registered VAT / tax ID (we can attach EU VAT certs)
- Bank details (account IBAN + SWIFT) and whether you need a PDF bank letter
- Primary remit currency (EUR / GBP / USD) and whether you accept multi-currency split payments
- PO matching rules: do you require 2-way match, 3-way match with receipt, or line-level PO numbers?
- Whether OxStream supports buyer self-billing (i.e., you issue invoice on our behalf) — if yes, please attach your self-billing agreement template or DocuSign link
- E-invoice options: Do you accept UBL 2.1, cXML, or a webhook payload (we can format UBL & send a test)
- Any required invoice filename conventions or mandatory fields (PO#, remit code, tax breakdown)

Two special items for this engagement: OxStream asked for a remit split across two of your legal entities in the EU (you mentioned EU Holdings Ltd and OxStream EU Services). If the portal requires separate vendor IDs per legal entity, please confirm whether you want us to:
  a) Upload two separate vendor records (one per remit entity) and send two invoices per PO, or
  b) Upload one vendor record with remit instructions and two separate invoice lines with distinct remit codes (your portal needs to support split remittance)

Attached are a stub W-9 for our US entity (for your records) and a sample invoice template we can produce in UBL/PDF.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm the minimal required documents (so we only sign/scan what you need).
2) If you require self-billing, send the DocuSign link and we will route to Legal for signature (target 48 hrs).
3) Provide test endpoint / sandbox credentials for e-invoice push if available.

Thanks — we can be flexible on format but would like to get the vendor token and first PO bound by the end of next week.

Best,

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@oxstream.com>

Cc: Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@oxstream.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 11:04:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Onboarding: OxStream AP portal, self-billing & remit-split requirements

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for the clear list. Below are our AP requirements and answers to your bullet points. Apologies for the long email but I wanted to be explicit so your upload is complete on first pass.

What we require from vendors (minimum):
- Legal entity name exactly as registered + company registration number (EU companies)
- VAT registration certificate (PDF) or EU VAT number for validation
- Bank details: IBAN + BIC and a bank confirmation letter if > €250k annual volume (PDF)
- Remit currency: we pay in EUR for EU entities; GBP for UK entities; USD for US entities. We can split a payment across two entities but our portal needs a remit code per invoice line to route funds to separate legal entities.
- PO matching: we do 2-way match by default. For software services (SaaS) we accept 2-way; if goods / deliverables involved we may require 3-way.
- Self-billing: we do offer buyer-issued invoices (self-billing) but we need a signed self-billing agreement. Please sign at the DocuSign link below. Once signed we will flag your vendor record as "self-bill enabled".
- E-invoice: sandbox supports UBL 2.1; we also accept cXML. We prefer UBL for tax line item structure. Sandbox endpoint: https://sandbox.oxstream.com/einvoice/accept (use basic auth: test/test).
- Mandatory invoice fields: PO Number (PO-12345 style), line-level remitCode when remit split required, VAT rate per line, supplier VAT id, invoice currency. Filename: {PO}_{InvoiceDate}_{SupplierName}.pdf (e.g. PO12345_20260630_Redwood.pdf)

DocuSign self-bill link: https://app.docusign.com/EmbeddedSigning?token=oxstream-selfbill-2026
HubSpot vendor request (internal): HS-4521

Regarding the remit-split option: we recommend option (a) — two vendor records — if your finance team prefers distinct vendor ledgers. Option (b) is supported but will require us to enable remitCode interpretation in our payments engine which can add 2–3 business days to processing.

Please upload your EU VAT certificate and complete the DocuSign. Once we receive signed self-bill agreement + VAT certs we can push a test PO and enable your sandbox access.

Regards,

Liam O'Connor
Head of Procurement Operations
OxStream Media
liam.oconnor@oxstream.com
+44 20 7946 0xxx

Hi Liam —

Appreciate the detail. Quick responses inline and a proposed plan: 

- We will upload two separate vendor records for the EU remit split (option a) — legal team prefers distinct vendor ledgers.
- VAT cert: attached (we will provide a notarized VAT document for the EU entity and the Redwood EU VAT registration PDF).
- DocuSign: routing to Legal now. Expect signature within 48 hours.
- E-invoice: we will produce UBL 2.1 XML + PDF. We can send a test payload to your sandbox endpoint by Tuesday.
- Invoice naming: we will adopt {PO}_{InvoiceDate}_{SupplierName}.pdf and include remitCode at line level if you ask us to switch to option (b) later.
- Payment terms: can you confirm your standard terms for this partnership? We typically invoice Net 45 for new enterprise customers; we also offer early-pay (1.5% / 15 days) opt-in if OxStream runs early-pay through your AR program.

Action plan:
1) We will upload two vendor records and attach VAT certs + bank stub (uploaded today).
2) Marissa will track DocuSign signature and confirm when self-bill flag is set.
3) We will push a UBL test invoice to your sandbox next week (Tuesday).

One question: for PO numbers created before vendor flag is set, will the PO still be payable after we are registered or do you require the vendor registration to pre-exist before a PO is approved? This impacts whether we ask Sales to wait for registration or proceed on the PO with manual remittances.

Thanks,

Rishi
